title: Exemption Request
description: A request from a user to be exempted from a set of rules.

id.description: The ID of the exemption request.

number.description: The number uniquely identifying the exemption request within its repository.

repository_id.description: The ID of the repository the exemption request is for.

requester_id.description: The ID of the user who requested the exemption.

requester_login.description: The login of the user who requested the exemption.

oneOf.title: Push ruleset bypass exemption request data
oneOf.description: Push rules that are being requested to be bypassed.

data.description: The data pertaining to the push rules that are being requested to be bypassed.

ruleset_id.description: The ID of the ruleset for the rules that were violated

ruleset_name.description: The name of the ruleset for the rules that were violated

rule_type.description: The type of rule that was violated

oneOf.title: Secret scanning push protection exemption request data
oneOf.description: Secret scanning push protections that are being requested to be bypassed.

data.description: The data pertaining to the secret scanning push protections that are being requested to be bypassed.

secret_type.description: The type of secret that was detected

locations.description: The location data of the secret that was detected

commit.description: The commit SHA where the secret was detected

branch.description: The branch where the secret was detected

path.description: The path of the file where the secret was detected

oneOf.title: Secret scanning alert dismissal request data
oneOf.description: Secret scanning alerts that have dismissal requests.

data.description: The data related to the secret scanning alerts that have dismissal requests.

reason.description: The reason for the dismissal request

secret_type.description: The type of secret that was detected

alert_number.description: The number of the alert that was detected

oneOf.title: Code scanning alert dismissal request data
oneOf.description: Code scanning alerts that have dismissal requests.

data.description: The data related to the code scanning alerts that have dismissal requests.

alert_number.description: The number of the alert to be dismissed

oneOf.title: Dependabot alert dismissal request data
oneOf.description: Dependabot alerts that have dismissal requests.

data.description: The data related to the Dependabot alerts that have dismissal requests.

alert_number.description: The number of the alert to be dismissed

oneOf.title: License compliance alert closure request data
oneOf.description: License compliance alerts that have closure requests.

data.description: The data related to the License compliance alerts that have closure requests.

alert_number.description: The number of the alert to be closed

resource_identifier.description: The unique identifier for the request type of the exemption request. For example, a commit SHA.

status.description: The status of the exemption request.

requester_comment.description: The comment the requester provided when creating the exemption request.

anyOf.title: Secret Scanning Push Protection Exemption Request Metadata
anyOf.description: Metadata for a secret scanning push protection exemption request.

label.description: The label for the secret type

reason.description: The reason for the exemption request

anyOf.title: Secret scanning alert dismissal request metadata
anyOf.description: Metadata for a secret scanning alert dismissal request.

alert_title.description: The title of the secret alert

reason.description: The reason for the dismissal request

anyOf.title: Code scanning alert dismissal request metadata
anyOf.description: Metadata for a code scanning alert dismissal request.

reason.description: The reason for the dismissal request

anyOf.title: Dependabot alert dismissal request metadata
anyOf.description: Metadata for a Dependabot alert dismissal request.

anyOf.title: License compliance alert closure request metadata
anyOf.description: Metadata for a License compliance alert closure request.

alert_title.description: The title of the License compliance alert

reason.description: The reason for the closure request

expires_at.description: The date and time the exemption request will expire.

created_at.description: The date and time the exemption request was created.

responses.description: The responses to the exemption request.

items.title: Exemption response
items.description: A response to an exemption request by a delegated bypasser.

id.description: The ID of the exemption response.

reviewer_id.description: The ID of the user who reviewed the exemption request.

reviewer_login.description: The login of the user who reviewed the exemption request.

status.description: The status of the exemption response.

reviewer_comment.description: The comment the reviewer provided when responding to the exemption request.

created_at.description: The date and time the exemption request was created.

html_url.description: The URL to view the exemption request in a browser.
